Initial release of gws-gmail skill.

- Enables sending, reading, and managing Gmail using gws CLI.
- Includes helper commands for sending mail, triaging inbox, and watching for new emails.
- Supports core Gmail API resources: users, drafts, history, labels, messages, settings, and threads.
- Offers commands to browse available methods and inspect parameter schemas.
- Requires gws binary and shared authentication/setup as specified in gws-shared.
